stages.note: Gemini 4 bills images per resolution tier (low=280, medium=560, high=1120) regardless of character density. Break-even triggers above ~600 text tokens.

monthly.cacheCrossoverRule: Implicit caching (-95% on prefix) only activates at >=4,096 prefix tokens. Below 4,096 tokens, pxpipe PNG wins. Above 4,096 static prefix tokens, stable cached text ($0.075/1M) can beat single uncached PNGs unless multi-page PNG prefix also exceeds 4,096 tokens.
